keyPoints: Samantar chaturbhuj me aamne-saamne ki bhujaen barabar aur samantar hoti hain — ye uski pehchaan bhi hai aur paribhasha bhi — inhi gunon se use pehchante hain.
Uske vikarn ek-doosre ko samdvibhajit karte hain; aamne-saamne ke kon barabar hote hain; lagatar kon sampurak hote hain.
Ek yugm bhujaen barabar-samantar hon to chaturbhuj samantar chaturbhuj hota hai — rachnaon aur siddhiyon me kaam aata hai — ek shart se poora chaturbhuj pakka ho jaata hai.
Aayat ke vikarn barabar hote hain; samachaturbhuj ke vikarn samkon par kaatte hain; varg me dono gun ek saath hote hain.
Madhya-bindu prameya: tribhuj ki do bhujaon ke madhya binduon ko jodne wali rekha teesri bhuja ke samantar aur aadhi hoti hai.
Samantar chaturbhuj ka kshetrafal = aadhar x unnat — yehi sutra aayat aur samachaturbhuj par bhi lagta hai.
Aam galti: vikarnon ke samdvibhajan ko har chaturbhuj ka gun samajhna — ye sirf samantar chaturbhuj (aur uske khaas roopon) me hota hai.
subject: Maths
title: Chaturbhuj: Samantar Chaturbhuj
